sampling.rule: Within each ecosystem, sort Linux load-verified frozen rows by registry_entry_id and select the first cached artifacts until the per-ecosystem target is met.

method.review_scope: For each locked artifact, manually reviewed framework-facing command and non-command handler registration declarations in source; no plugin was imported or executed. Ground truth means the source contains at least one applicable declaration.
method.reviewer: Codex (single reviewer; not independent human double annotation)
method.measurement: Per-plugin presence of at least one declared command or non-command handler; this does not measure exact registration counts or name accuracy.

decision.basis: The command-presence gate is applied only to this deterministic 60-entry source sample. Item-name quality, runtime-versus-static agreement, and catalog-wide discovery remain unmeasured.

limitations: The sample is deterministic by registry ID and cache availability, not randomized; rates are not an ecosystem-wide estimate.
Labels come from one source-review pass, not independent human double annotation.
Static item counts and names may be duplicated across source and built files or left unknown when registration arguments are dynamic.
Runtime inventories are tested with self-authored Host fixtures; these third-party plugins were not loaded or executed.

review.method: manual source review of framework registration declarations in the locked source artifact
review.scope_note: Binary plugin-presence label; command aliases, exact counts, runtime activation, and dynamically generated registrations are not ground truth in this pass.
